name: expgauge

headline.en: When was the last time a human checked on your agent?
headline.zh: 你的 agent 已经无人看管多久了？

sub.en: expgauge tracks cumulative unsupervised exposure — wall-clock time, state-mutating tool calls, and token burn — and forces a human review checkpoint before things go sideways.
sub.zh: expgauge 追踪累计暴露量（运行时长、状态变更、token 消耗），在越过阈值时强制暂停，等待人工审查后才放行。

body.en: Not per-action risk grading, not per-request metrics. expgauge accumulates wall-clock time since your last review, counts state-mutating filesystem events, and estimates token burn across the whole agent run.
body.zh: 不是单次操作的风险评级，不是单次请求的指标。expgauge 累计自上次审查以来的运行时长、统计状态变更的文件系统事件、估算整个 agent 运行期间的 token 消耗。

body.en: When cumulative exposure crosses a configurable threshold (default: 2 hours / 50 mutations / 1M tokens), expgauge sends SIGTSTP to the agent process and blocks on a human review prompt. The agent cannot continue until you say yes.
body.zh: 当累计暴露量越过可配置阈值（默认：2 小时 / 50 次变更 / 100 万 token），expgauge 向 agent 进程发送 SIGTSTP 并阻塞在人工审查提示上。agent 在你确认前不会继续运行。

body.en: Qwen3.8 running 8+ hours non-stop. DeepSeek-Reasonix at 35k stars saying 'leave it running.' The local-model economics make unattended runs viable — expgauge is the safety layer for that paradigm.
body.zh: Qwen3.8 连续 8 小时不停。DeepSeek-Reasonix 35k 星标榜'leave it running'。本地模型的经济性让无人值守运行成为可能——expgauge 就是这个模式的安全层。

note.en: expgauge watches your agent process, renders a live TUI badge, and pauses at thresholds.
note.zh: expgauge 监控你的 agent 进程，渲染实时 TUI 徽章，在阈值触发时暂停。

quickstart.title: Get started
quickstart.body: Install and run expgauge in under a minute.

limitations: expgauge estimates token burn by parsing agent logs; accuracy depends on log format.
Force-pause uses SIGTSTP (Unix only); no-op on Windows.
Filesystem mutation detection uses fsnotify; network-mounted paths may have event latency.

body.zh: DeepSeek-Reasonix 有 35,000 星标，它说'leave it running'——让 agent 一直跑。Qwen3.8 让本地模型连续 8 小时工作成为现实。但是当 agent 无人看管地运行数小时，谁来喊停？
body.en: DeepSeek-Reasonix has 35,000 stars and says 'leave it running.' Qwen3.8 makes 8-hour non-stop local agent work a reality. But when an agent runs unsupervised for hours, who calls a halt?

title.zh: 暴露不是单次操作的风险

body.zh: 传统 LLM 可观测性工具（LangSmith、Helicone）追踪单次请求的延迟和成本。但无人值守的暴露是时间性的——自上次人工审查以来过了多久，发生了多少状态变更。expgauge 引入了一个新的流原语：运行级暴露徽章。
body.en: Traditional LLM observability tools (LangSmith, Helicone) track per-request latency and cost. But unsupervised exposure is temporal — how long since a human looked, how many state mutations occurred. expgauge introduces a new flow primitive: the run-level exposure badge.

title.zh: 从'I Have Been Clawed'到预防
title.en: From 'I Have Been Clawed' to prevention

body.zh: 社区建了 I Have Been Clawed——一个 coding agent 事故索引。但它是事后编目，不是事前预防。expgauge 在事故发生前就强制你回头看一眼。
body.en: The community built I Have Been Clawed — an index of coding agent incidents. But it catalogs after damage, not before. expgauge forces you to look back before things go wrong.

body.zh: 默认阈值：2 小时运行时长 / 50 次状态变更 / 100 万 token 消耗。所有阈值都可在 ~/.expgauge.yaml 中按项目覆盖。
body.en: Default thresholds: 2h wall-clock / 50 mutations / 1M tokens. All configurable via ~/.expgauge.yaml with per-project overrides.

details.code:
# ~/.expgauge.yaml
thresholds:
  wall_clock_sec: 7200
  mutations: 50
  tokens: 1000000
watch_paths:
  - ./src
  - ./configs
agent:
  name_pattern: "deepseek|qwen|reasonix"
